title: Concept: Framework data-layer query exception disclosed in a response
description: Laravel, Rails, Django and Doctrine all wrap the database message together with the SQL and its bindings, and they name the framework in the stack. A public response containing one therefore discloses schema, parameter values and the framework version at the same time.
applicability: Responses generated by a Laravel, Rails, Django or Doctrine application.
risk: The caller learns the schema and the bound parameters of a failed query, plus the framework version, which selects the next set of known issues to try.
